artworks.title: Oceanus and Tethys (Zeugma mosaic)
artworks.description: Roman floor mosaic from the ancient city of Zeugma on the Euphrates, now in the Zeugma Mosaic Museum in Gaziantep, Turkey. Tethys, the Titan goddess of the nourishing waters, appears beside her consort Oceanus amid fish and sea creatures of the world-encircling river.

artworks.title: Oceanus and Tethys (Antakya mosaic)
artworks.description: Late Roman mosaic in the Hatay Archaeology Museum, Antakya: Oceanus and Tethys face one another among marine creatures — the Titan sea-parents as Antiochene floor luxury.

artworks.title: Oceanus and Tethys (Zeugma, detail)
artworks.description: A closer view of the Zeugma Oceanus–Tethys pavement in Gaziantep: the sea-mother's face and watery crown amid the tesserae of the world-river.

artworks.title: Mosaic of Oceanos and Tethys
artworks.description: Another Zeugma Museum view of the Oceanos and Tethys floor: the Titan couple framed by fish and dragon-like ketos — nourishing waters laid in stone for a Euphrates villa.

popCulture.title: Tethys (moon)
popCulture.description: Saturn's icy moon keeps the sea-mother's name beside Oceanus — Tethys among the outer planets' courts.
